mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A 25 basis point reduction in the federal funds rate within a 3-month window signals aggressive monetary easing, which boosts equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS falls > 0.25pp in 3 months, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising does not produce positive 60-day returns in at least 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer confidence and strong housing starts, the S&P 500 tends to rise as corporate earnings benefit from robust domestic consumption; this effect is most pronounced in the early stages of an economic expansion.
failure_condition: In the early-cycle expansion regime (defined by HOUST > 550 and RSAFS > 380000), the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth does not lead to positive 5-day S&P 500 returns in more than 55% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate above 2.5% signals robust economic expansion, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 quarterly growth exceeds 2.5%, the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment and declining labor force participation, the S&P 500 tends to underperform as economic weakness dampens corporate earnings; this effect is most pronounced during late-cycle economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: In late-cycle slowdown regimes (UNRATE > 8.5%), the S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of declining federal funds rate and rising inflation (as measured by CPI) signals a central bank's attempt to stimulate the economy amid rising prices, which typically leads to positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of FEDFUNDS falling and CPIAUCSL rising does not produce positive 5-day returns in at least 60% of instances.
